summary: Bound local collection reads with typed SQL push-down, while retaining the pre-2.0 generic-store fallback when a typed table is empty or only partially populated.
reason: Unbounded generic-list materialization exhausted memory for small requested result sets, but upgraded stores can retain generic rows that a filtered 2.0 sync has not copied into the typed table. Because every typed upsert writes both partitions transactionally, typed push-down is authoritative only when its row count is nonzero and at least the generic resource count. Limit is applied before parent scope; this latent ordering is acceptable here because Seats.aero has no parented local paths.
validated_outcome: Tests verify empty and partially populated typed tables fall back to generic rows with migration hints, including an end-to-end partial routes read; a complete nonempty typed-table miss remains final without streaming. Existing tests cover bounded streaming, missing-key equality, offsets, and cursor warnings.
